sources.title: Cross collateral: eligible collateral assets for perpetual futures
sources.claim: XRP is listed as an eligible cross-collateral asset for Coinbase International Exchange perpetual futures; collateral weights, asset limits, maintenance margin and automatic liquidation apply.
sources.limitation: Eligibility does not disclose actual XRP collateral balances or utilization.

sources.title: Borrow USDC against crypto including XRP through Morpho on Base
sources.claim: Eligible US users can borrow up to $100,000 USDC against XRP through a Morpho-backed onchain loan on Base using Coinbase's interface; collateral is represented as cbXRP and subject to asset-specific LTV/liquidation rules.
sources.limitation: Morpho onchain loan, not Coinbase balance-sheet lending; aggregate XRP collateral and utilization undisclosed.

existing_claim_crosswalk.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q does not separately name XRP in recognized collateral tables. Lending collateral includes BTC, ETH and $9.903M aggregate other crypto; no individual other asset exceeded 5% of total crypto collateral. Recognized derivatives collateral lists BTC and ETH at September 30. This is actual recognized collateral, not the full eligibility universe.

Circle Q2 2026 10-Q reports $655.3M H1 distribution costs to Coinbase; USDC circulation $73.3B, onchain volume $14.8T and 27% market share. The 19.5% platform statistic is Circle's platform, not Coinbase's.
SBI disclosed approximately 9% Ripple shareholding as of 2025 and SBI Remit XRP bridge use since 2021; current ownership percentage not refreshed.
SBI Ripple Asia is a 60% SBI / 40% Ripple JV; XRPL tokenized-deposit and cross-border research POCs do not establish native XRP use in those POCs.
SBI and Circle formed a Japan JV; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank announced a combined $50M investment in Circle's 2025 IPO.
SBI VC Trade RLUSD service launched June 24, 2026; current network support Ethereum, with XRPL planned, not verified live.
JPYSC is trust-issued and initially distributed through SBI VC Trade accounts; public-chain circulation not established.
SBI/Startale joined Open Standard with Coinbase among founding partners; JPYSC/OUSD interoperability is a PoC under consideration, not a live XRP route.
Tokyo SBIC is a regional SME investment/consultation company, distinct from SBI Holdings and the SBI-Circle Japan JV; ChatGPT seminars are educational.

notes: New Coinbase documents establish eligibility, not actual collateral utilization.
The Q3 10-Q collateral tables report recognized balances at September 30, not the full eligibility universe.
The cbXRP/Morpho USDC route is on Base, not a direct Circle loan or Coinbase balance-sheet loan.
No new market feature admitted; forecast NOT_ISSUED.
